answer_1.quote: We adopt natural language generation metrics, i.e., ROUGE L (R L ) , BERTScore (BS) , and accuracy (Acc) to assess the quality of generated feedback.
answer_1.outputs: The paper generates natural language feedback for CAD program errors and edits CAD programs based on reference images.

answer_2.quote: We adopt natural language generation metrics, i.e., ROUGE L (R L ) , BERTScore (BS) , and accuracy (Acc) to assess the quality of generated feedback. ... we utilize chamfer distance (CD), minimum matching distance (MMD), Jensen-Shannon divergence (JSD), and invalidity ratio (IR) to evaluate the consistency between 3D point clouds of the edited and ground truth 3D objects.

answer_4.quote: We invite five volunteer designers familiar with OpenSCAD to evaluate based on the following criteria: Readability (Red) measures how clear and understandable is the edited code to a human designer. Reusability (Reu) refers to what extent can the edited code be reused or extended to other 3D objects. Preservation (Pre) represents how well the edited code maintains the original functionality while eliminating errors.
answer_4.guideline: The evaluation criteria include Readability, Reusability, and Preservation, with scores on a scale from 0 to 2, where higher values indicate greater alignment with human-edited code.
